The *Pañcakauddesa* (Pp 1.5) is a section of the *Puggalapaññatti*, the fourth book of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. In keeping with the structural arrangement of the *Puggalapaññatti*, it serves as the schedule or table of contents (*uddesa*) listing the classifications of persons grouped in sets of five (*pañcaka*) before their detailed treatment in the treatise [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. SuttaCentral records one modern translation in one language [SuttaCentral].
According to DharmaNexus, the text exhibits significant Pali-internal text reuse, with 220 matching passages identified across 11 other Pali works [DharmaNexus]. In the *Puggalapaññatti* itself, its headings directly correspond to and share substantial material with the *Pañcakapuggalapaññatti* (Pp 2.5), which provides the subsequent full exposition [DharmaNexus]. Substantial segments are also shared with Sutta Piṭaka collections, particularly the *Saḷāyatana Saṁyutta* (SN 35), the *Dasakanipāta* (AN 10), and the *Pañcakanipāta* (AN 5), in addition to the *Madhupiṇḍika Sutta* (MN 18) and *Mahātaṇhāsaṅkhaya Sutta* (MN 38) [DharmaNexus]. Further shared text appears in the Abhidhamma commentarial tradition, including the *Pañcapakaraṇa-aṭṭhakathā*, the *Vibhaṅga-mūlaṭīkā*, the *Aṅguttaranikāye Pañcakanipāta-ṭīkā*, and the *Visuddhimagga-mahāṭīkā* [DharmaNexus]. In cross-language automated alignments, DharmaNexus detects matches with the Sanskrit *Mahāvyutpatti* and a Tibetan translation of the *Vimuktimārgadhautaguṇanirdeśa* [DharmaNexus].
